fields.summary: Amendment No. 3 to the lease-leaseback contract with Overaa/Tulum/Eclipse covers $220,000 for extended preconstruction services and $50,031.69 of lease interest that was not included in the guaranteed maximum price, for a total increase of $270,031.69. The preconstruction work was help negotiating with vendors from the ended Phase I and value-engineering before the price was set. The attached amendment puts the contract price, including Change Orders 1-5 and this amendment, at $51,450,180.66; the starting total in the agenda text does not match the attachment.

21-1602.sourceIssue: The official text's numbers don't add up: $50,551,133.91 plus $270,031.69 is $50,821,165.60, but it states a new total of $51,450,180.66. The attachment confirms the $270,031.69 increase and the $51,450,180.66 total but not the $50,551,133.91 starting figure.

21-1943.sourceIssue: The text lists 2280 hours at $40 an hour, which equals $91,200, but the not-to-exceed amount is stated as $91,400. The attached agreement also states $91,400 as the cap without explaining the $200 difference.

fields.summary: The district is paying an individual contractor for 540 hours at $40 an hour, which comes to the $21,600 cap, to support teachers in classroom lessons on drug education, holistic health, and how race, law and politics affect incarceration and exploitation of youth. It also covers Tobacco Use Prevention Education services. The service period is August 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022, and the board is approving it after the start date. The agenda text says 548 hours; the attached agreement says 540.

21-1946.sourceIssue: The text lists 548 hours at $40.00 per hour, which equals $21,920, but the not-to-exceed amount is stated as $21,600. The attached agreement says 540 hours, which equals $21,600.

fields.summary: Amendment No. 2 extends Robert Half International's agreement, which supplies people to do data entry on campuses for the district's COVID response, through September 1, 2022. It raises the contract limit by $1,500,000, from $495,000 to $1,995,000 according to the signed amendment; the agenda text misprints the new total as $1,955,000. All other terms stay the same.

21-2218.note: Corrected: the new total is $1,995,000, as stated in the attached amendment, not the $1,955,000 printed in the agenda text.
21-2218.sourceIssue: The official text's numbers don't add up: $495,000 plus $1,500,000 is $1,995,000, but it states a new total of $1,955,000. The attached amendment states $1,995,000.
